facts.claim: CLI sets defaultToolAutoApprove = true; precedence is --auto-approve flag > global-settings.json toolAutoApprove > default
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: `cline --help`: 'Default to start in act mode with auto-approve enabled'; ACP mode defaults to false
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Command safety is decided by the model's requires_approval flag, 'Cline does not use a fixed allowlist'
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: VS Code DEFAULT_AUTO_APPROVAL_SETTINGS: readFiles/editFiles/useBrowser/useMcp true, executeSafeCommands false, executeAllCommands true (legacy fields)
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Mindgard: prompt injection made Cline run 'ping' (treated as safe, no approval) to exfiltrate keys via DNS; published 2025-11-18
facts.label: third-party-report

D01.rationale: CLI ships with tool auto-approve ON by default and persists it in global-settings.json; VS Code has per-category toggles but legacy-named 'executeAllCommands' defaults true and approval of commands is model-flagged (requires_approval), not a rule list.

facts.claim: No sandbox mechanism for agent tool execution found in source/docs; the 'sandbox' option applies only to plugin code isolation
facts.label: from-official-docs

D02.rationale: No OS sandbox for tool execution in CLI or VS Code extension.

facts.claim: No domain allowlist config found; ping/curl-type commands rely on model flagging
facts.label: from-official-docs

D03.rationale: No egress controls; network reachable via shell and browser tool.

facts.claim: Hook search paths include <workspace>/.clinerules/hooks and <workspace>/.cline/hooks
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Project plugins in <repo>/.cline/plugins are available when working in that project (JS/TS modules executed by CLI/SDK)
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: No 'trust' gate in apps/cli or sdk core for workspace config (grep of source); not tested at runtime
facts.label: unverified

D04.rationale: Workspace hooks, plugins, rules and skills are discovered from the cwd with no folder-trust prompt in the CLI.

facts.claim: MCP settings file ~/.cline/data/settings/cline_mcp_settings.json, key mcpServers, fields command/args/env/url/headers/type/disabled/autoApprove
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Remote-config MCP controls (marketplace on/off, own servers allowed, org servers) supported only in VS Code and JetBrains, not CLI/Desktop
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Hub dashboard (GHSA-3cj3-hqcr-g934) allowed cross-origin WebSocket to upsert_mcp_server, injecting a stdio MCP server entry; affected cline<=3.0.24
facts.label: from-official-docs

D05.rationale: MCP is user-level only (no project MCP file), per-server autoApprove tool lists, OAuth for remote; no tool-description pinning; org MCP controls only in VS Code/JetBrains remote config.

facts.claim: `cline plugin install` accepts file URL, git repo (clones + installs prod deps), npm package, local path
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Plugin tools still go through toolPolicies; sandbox mode opt-in
facts.label: from-official-docs

D06.rationale: Plugins installable from npm/git/URL/local and executed as JS/TS; skills from repo dirs; no signing/vetting described.

facts.claim: providers.json written with mode 0o600 inside 0o700 dir
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: .clineignore 'is not a security or access-control boundary — ignored files can still be read via explicit @ mentions or shell commands'
facts.label: from-official-docs

D07.rationale: Provider keys plaintext in providers.json with 0600/0700 perms; .clineignore explicitly not an access boundary; MCP env plaintext.

facts.claim: Headless CI usage documented as `cline --yolo "..."`; yolo disables spawn/team tools by default
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Clinejection: issue-triage workflow using claude-code-action with attacker-controlled issue title -> cache poisoning -> release token theft (Adnan Khan, disclosed 2026-02-09)
facts.label: third-party-report

D08.rationale: CLI --yolo / default auto-approve in headless; JSON mode; no official CI action hardening; the project's own CI was the Clinejection vector.

D09.rationale: N/A (no built-in agent-writable memory store; rules/skills are user-authored files).

facts.claim: enableSpawnAgent/enableAgentTeams = !isYoloMode
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: subagentsEnabled default false (VS Code state key)
facts.label: from-official-docs

D10.rationale: Sub-agents/agent teams exist; --yolo disables them by default; VS Code subagentsEnabled defaults false; permission inheritance not documented.

facts.claim: Sessions under ~/.cline/data/sessions, `cline history export`
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: OpenTelemetry + prompt-storage docs for enterprise monitoring
facts.label: from-official-docs

D11.rationale: Local session store + checkpoints + enterprise OpenTelemetry export and prompt storage.

facts.claim: 'Telemetry is on by default in the VS Code and JetBrains extensions, Cline Desktop and the CLI'; set telemetryOptOut true in global-settings.json
facts.label: from-official-docs

D12.rationale: Telemetry on by default across products, documented opt-out (telemetryOptOut), excludes code/prompts except for Cline/ClinePass providers.

facts.claim: GHSA-9ppg-jx86-fqw7: compromised npm token published cline@2.3.0 with postinstall installing openclaw (~8h, 2026-02-17); publishing moved to OIDC provenance
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: cli-publish.yml sets NPM_CONFIG_PROVENANCE=true with id-token: write
facts.label: from-official-docs

D13.rationale: npm releases now published with provenance after the Feb 2026 token compromise; VSIX/marketplace signing and installer checksums not documented.

facts.claim: Remote config controls table: rules yes in VS Code & CLI; providers/MCP/telemetry VS Code/JetBrains only; 'Allow YOLO mode' listed No for all three
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: yoloModeAllowed:false disables YOLO toggle (enterprise doc)
facts.label: from-official-docs

D14.rationale: Hosted remote-config (admin console) can force rules, providers, MCP and yoloModeAllowed=false; coverage differs per product and CLI/Desktop are largely excluded.
